description: Storage v2 write answers that need a whole 256 KiB write granule persisted, which no recording covers and gcs-mimic decided by inference, on a bucket of its own. Three messages carry 262144 zero bytes with their crc32c (4029857011); every other message carries at most one zero byte. Resumable WriteObject: a stream that closes after exactly one granule without finish_write, and QueryWriteStatus after it (the persisted size the session reports). The same session, now with a persisted size of 262144, is then resumed with a first write_offset past it (262145), at 0 and inside it (131072), each sending one zero byte that matches the persisted content without finish_write and followed by QueryWriteStatus, and finally at exactly the persisted size with one byte and finish_write (gcs-mimic refuses a first offset below a persisted size above 0, inferred from the proto's write_offset). A second session with an object_size of 262143 receives one granule without finish_write, which goes past object_size, then QueryWriteStatus: whether that message is refused and whether the session stays usable or is terminated. BidiWriteObject without an upload_id: one stream sends a granule with state_lookup (the persisted size reported after 256 KiB was sent without flush), then a message with flush and state_lookup at exactly one granule, then one byte with finish_write. Session starts capture the upload_id and are not compared. Asks RPC-STORAGE-018, RPC-STORAGE-019, RPC-STORAGE-023 and BEHAVIOR-RPC-003 stream_resume_offset and stream_single_flush (SPEC-GRPC-LOCAL-CHOICES).
